# Every third-party dependency this payload installs from source, with the
# hash of every sdist uv resolved. Installed with --require-hashes so a
# compromised or substituted PyPI/Datadog-mirror release fails the build
# instead of shipping silently (see docs/create-and-use-a-package.md, "Pin
# and track every input"). The datadog_checks_base/integration local paths
# this stage also installs are not here: they come straight from the
# checksummed integrations-core git checkout above, not an index fetch, so
# a hash would protect nothing a tampered checkout couldn't already defeat.
#
# This file is generated from requirements-thirdparty.txt, next to it. That
# file pins every package, direct and transitive, because the compile uses
# --no-deps. Its header says how the list is built from integrations-core
# and how a CVE override is written. Do not edit this lock by hand.
#
# Regenerate after any change to requirements-thirdparty.txt, and whenever
# INTEGRATIONS_CORE_VERSION bumps (rebuild requirements-thirdparty.txt first).
# Run from this directory. uv must be the version the build uses (uv==0.13.6
# in .datadog-agent.inc.yaml). The command keeps this header:
#
#   { sed -n '/^[^#]/q;p' requirements-lock.txt
#     uvx uv@0.13.6 pip compile requirements-thirdparty.txt \
#       --python-version 3.13 --python-platform linux --no-binary :all: \
#       --no-deps --generate-hashes --no-header; } > requirements-lock.new
#   mv requirements-lock.new requirements-lock.txt
#
# CVE fix: set the new version in requirements-thirdparty.txt with an
# "# override: <CVE id>" note, then regenerate. uv drops comments, so the
# note lives in that file, not on the lines below.
#
# One lock serves both arches. pymqi is amd64 only (IBM ships no arm64
# redistributable), so assemble-payload-requirements.py strips it from this
# lock on arm64 before install. The sdist hashes are the same on both arches.
#
# Changing this file changes no tracked variable, so bump INTEGRATIONS_REL
# by hand when the lock changes without a VERSION or
# INTEGRATIONS_CORE_VERSION bump.
